clue.text: Girl keeping house for junior doctor at island left by prisoners' friend

indicators.note: keeping means holding something within, so the girl's name wraps round the next piece

parts.note: Amy is a girl's name
a nest is a bird's house
an intern is a junior hospital doctor
taken as written
Iona is a small island in the Inner Hebrides

explanation.surface: A girl looks after a house for a young doctor on an island the prisoners' friend has abandoned.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer runs across three lights; 'keeping' is the container signal, and 'for' and 'by' only join the pieces. Iona is a small Hebridean island.
explanation.definitionFit: The human-rights organisation campaigns for political prisoners and prisoners of conscience, so it is their friend.

clue.text: One going by train is for the birds

parts.note: one as the indefinite article a
via means going by way of
RY, short for railway, stands for train travel

explanation.surface: Travelling by rail is only for the birds, a dismissive remark.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for the birds' looks like slang for worthless; read literally, a place built for birds.
explanation.definitionFit: An enclosure housing birds is literally provided for them, the slang phrase taken at face value.

clue.text: Pretty good agreement about to be announced

indicators.note: about means round, so the nod is placed around the abbreviation

parts.note: a nod signals agreement

explanation.surface: A fairly satisfactory deal is about to be made public.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about to be announced' reads as one phrase, but 'about' is the container signal and 'to be announced' gives TBA.
explanation.definitionFit: The colloquial phrase is mild praise, meaning reasonably or fairly good.

clue.text: Among pigs, Jabberwocky beasts get physical education with dance

indicators.note: among puts the following pieces inside the pigs' home

parts.note: a sty is where pigs live
the mome raths outgrabe in Lewis Carroll's poem Jabberwocky

explanation.surface: Nonsense-poem creatures mixed with pigs do a PE class and a dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Among' is the container signal; 'get' and 'with' only link. Mome raths come from Lewis Carroll's nonsense poem.
explanation.definitionFit: A strathspey is a slow Scottish country dance, a specific example of a dance.

clue.text: Long time before 6

parts.note: a year is a period of time
the answer to 6 down is midday, abbreviated n. in dictionaries

explanation.surface: A long period of time ahead of the next clue.
explanation.walkthrough: '6' points to the answer at 6 down, the middle of the day, and its abbreviation is n.
explanation.definitionFit: To long for something is to desire it keenly, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Point accepted by one engaged in money matters

indicators.note: accepted by means taken in by, so the compass point goes inside the engaged person

parts.note: a fiance is a man engaged to be married
N, north, is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: A remark is taken up by someone busy with financial business.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one engaged' seems to mean busy, but it is a betrothed man, FIANCE.
explanation.definitionFit: Finance covers the management of money, so money matters is a plain synonym.

clue.text: Sought compliments about vessel prepared for occupation

indicators.note: about means around, so the verb surrounds the vessel

parts.note: to fish for compliments is to seek them
an urn is a vessel

explanation.surface: Someone angled for praise about a vase ready for living in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' is the container signal. To fish for compliments is to angle for praise.
explanation.definitionFit: A house fitted with furniture is ready to be lived in, which is occupation.

clue.text: … twice each way

indicators.note: each way means the word reads the same from both directions

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis carries on from the clue number: 6 twice is twelve, the hour of midday, and that word reads the same backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Six doubled is twelve, and twelve o'clock in the daytime is midday.

clue.text: See 1 across
Query the manner in which I turn red

indicators.note: in which says the answer sits inside the words just before

explanation.surface: Someone asks about the way they blush.
explanation.walkthrough: The run ERYTHEMA lies across the end of Query, all of the and the start of manner.
explanation.definitionFit: Erythema is the medical term for reddening of the skin, so the condition speaks of blushing.

clue.text: See 1
Harry and I — two, that makes — ready to go up

indicators.note: makes signals that the letters of the words named are made into something new

explanation.surface: Harry and I make two, a couple ready to rise.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of HARRY, I and TWO are rearranged; 'that' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: An aircraft fit to fly is safe to take into the air.

clue.text: Actual number taking wrong turn in game

parts.note: real means actual
ten is a number

indicators.note: turn means the word for wrong is read backwards

parts.note: a sin is a wrong

explanation.surface: A real number takes a wrong turn during a match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn' reverses SIN to give NIS; 'taking' and 'in' only link. Real tennis is the old indoor court game from which lawn tennis came.
explanation.definitionFit: Real tennis is a racket game played in an enclosed court, so it is one example of a game.

clue.text: Bear use of ringback?

indicators.note: back means the word for ring is read in reverse

parts.note: a hoop is a ring

explanation.surface: A bear asks about using a phone's call-back service.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ringback' looks like a phone service, but it splits into ring, HOOP, and back, the reversal signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Winnie-the-Pooh is A. A. Milne's famous teddy bear.

clue.text: Craft book about means of shooting snake

indicators.note: about means around, so the book's letters surround the next pieces

parts.note: NT, the New Testament, is a book of the Bible
an arrow is shot from a bow
a boa is a snake

explanation.surface: A book about shooting a snake, a craft guide.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' is the container signal; 'book' as the New Testament is a crossword staple.
explanation.definitionFit: A narrowboat is a long canal boat, a kind of water craft.

clue.text: Burrow to cure limb and make sure one gets up

parts.note: a sett is a badger's burrow
to heal is to cure
an arm is a limb

explanation.surface: A badger's home mends a limb and wakes someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and' only joins the wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Setting the alarm clock ensures a sleeper wakes and rises on time, an idiom.

clue.text: Make a mistake with story about space traveller — all gold then and no silver or bronze?

definitions.text: all gold then and no silver or bronze?

parts.note: to trip is to make a mistake

indicators.note: about means around, so the story surrounds the space traveller

parts.note: a lie is a story
ET is the alien from Spielberg's film

explanation.surface: A blunder with a tall tale about an alien ends in a medal tie.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' only links. If three competitors tie for first, all get gold and nobody wins silver or bronze.
explanation.definitionFit: A three-way tie for first place would hand out three golds, leaving no lower medals.

clue.text: Model causes annoyance with underground delicacies

parts.note: the Ford Model T gives T
ruffles means irritates

explanation.surface: A fashion model annoys people over fancy food.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Model' wants to be a person; it is the Model T car, giving T. 'with' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: Truffles are prized edible fungi that grow beneath the soil.

clue.text: Chap with no head embracing Andrew, strangely moving

indicators.note: embracing means holding inside, so the trimmed word goes round the next piece
with no head means the first letter of the chap's word is dropped

parts.note: a guy is a chap

indicators.note: strangely signals that the name's letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A headless man hugs Andrew in an oddly touching way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with no head' drops a first letter, 'strangely' rearranges the name, and 'embracing' wraps one result round the other, giving U + NDERWA + Y.
explanation.definitionFit: Something under way is in progress, set in motion.

clue.text: I can tell how far it's managed, if altered in sex

parts.note: ran means managed

indicators.note: in places the rearranged word inside the word for sex

parts.note: gender is used for sex

indicators.note: altered says the two letters swap order

explanation.surface: Something managed shows its range once a gender change is made.
explanation.walkthrough: 'altered' rearranges two letters and 'in' is the container signal. 'it's' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: A rangefinder is an instrument that measures the distance to an object.

clue.text: More complete cleaner for cloth

definitions.meaning: ... means ... in the comparative sense, more full
a worker who cleans and thickens woollen cloth

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both the comparative of full and an old trade name for a cloth cleaner.

clue.text: Wartime heroine of old men to the odds

indicators.note: odds means the odd-numbered letters of the words before are taken

explanation.surface: A war heroine from the old days against the odds.
explanation.walkthrough: Take the first, third, fifth letters and so on of 'old men to the'; 'of' only links. Odette Sansom was a British SOE agent in occupied France.
explanation.definitionFit: Odette Sansom was a decorated Second World War agent, a famous wartime heroine.

clue.text: Have a meal and get paid?

definitions.meaning: to eat is to take food, as animals do

explanation.definitionFit: To feed is to eat, and fee'd jokingly means paid a fee.

clue.text: Slight injury located around Welsh fiasco

indicators.note: around means the word for located surrounds the next piece

parts.note: found means located

indicators.note: fiasco suggests a mess, so the letters of the word before are jumbled

explanation.surface: A minor wound was found during a Welsh disaster.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Welsh fiasco' reads as a Welsh disaster, but 'fiasco' is the anagram signal and 'around' the container signal; Welsh here is plain letters, not a nationality.
explanation.definitionFit: A flesh wound is a superficial injury that does not reach bone or organs.

clue.text: Beast — make sure it goes the right way

definitions.meaning: a young castrated bull, a beast

definitions.text: make sure it goes the right way

explanation.definitionFit: The word is a bullock and also the verb for guiding a vehicle's direction.

clue.text: Totter in turn with 3

definitions.meaning: a Scottish dance that follows the slow dance at 3 down in a set

explanation.walkthrough: In Scottish country dancing a strathspey (3 down) and a quicker dance are often played one after the other.
explanation.definitionFit: To reel is to stagger, and a reel is the fast dance paired with a strathspey.

clue.text: Clue to a place for advice: Spooner gets Saul to come in?

indicators.note: Spooner signals the opening sounds of the words are swapped

parts.note: Saul is the Biblical king, or Paul's earlier name
to enter is to come in

explanation.surface: A clue to an advice bureau where Saul is told to enter.
explanation.walkthrough: Said as SAU LENTER, the swap of the L and S sounds gives the answer. 'Clue to a' also hints that A is the middle of LAW.
explanation.definitionFit: A law centre is a British office giving free legal advice.

clue.text: Little bird finds love with permit

parts.note: love is nil in tennis, the letter O
to let is to permit

explanation.surface: A fledgling finds affection and permission.
explanation.walkthrough: 'finds' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: An owlet is a young owl, so a small bird.

clue.text: Cerulean island sounded aloud

indicators.note: aloud says the two words are to be heard rather than read

parts.note: Skye is a Hebridean island and blew means sounded, as a horn

explanation.surface: A sky-coloured island is announced.
explanation.walkthrough: Skye and blew spoken together match the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Cerulean is a deep clear blue like the colour of a cloudless sky.

clue.text: I'm no longer working on Hebridean island

parts.note: re means on, concerning
Tiree is an island in the Inner Hebrides

explanation.surface: A pensioner lives on a Scottish island.
explanation.definitionFit: A retiree has stopped working, so speaks the phrase about themselves.
